ticker_news.title: HERE Technologies retains #1 ranking in Omdia’s 2025 Location Platform Index, setting the pace for software-defined vehicles and AI innovation
ticker_news.description: HERE Technologies has been ranked #1 in Omdia's 2025 Location Platform Index, ahead of competitors Google, TomTom, and Mapbox. The ranking recognizes HERE's innovation in AI-powered mapping, strategic partnerships with AWS and automotive leaders, and advancements in software-defined vehicles. Key achievements include a $1B AWS partnership for the SDV Accelerator and expansion into fleet management and IoT solutions.
ticker_news.author: Na
